name: dev.ucp.shopping.buyer_consent
title: Buyer Consent Extension
description: Extends Checkout with buyer consent tracking for privacy compliance via the buyer object.

marketing_consent_option.description: A marketing channel the business offers for buyer opt-in.

description.description: What the buyer is consenting to receive, e.g., 'promotional emails, product launches, and exclusive offers'. Platforms MAY use this to compose their own display text.

privacy_policy_url.description: URL to the business's privacy policy governing use of the buyer's contact information for marketing.

marketing_consent.description: Buyer's consent decision for a specific marketing channel.

opted_in.description: Whether the buyer consented to receive marketing via this channel.

consent.description: User consent states for data processing

analytics.description: Consent for analytics and performance tracking.

marketing.description: Deprecated. Use marketing_consents for channel-specific consent. When true, indicates blanket consent for all marketing channels.

marketing_consents.description: Channel-specific marketing consent decisions. Platforms SHOULD include this when the checkout response includes marketing_consent_options. Omission or empty array is treated as no consent given for any channel.

sale_of_data.description: Consent for selling data to third parties (CCPA).

buyer.title: Buyer with Consent
buyer.description: Buyer object extended with consent tracking.

dev.ucp.shopping.checkout.title: Checkout with Buyer Consent
dev.ucp.shopping.checkout.description: Checkout extended with consent tracking via buyer object and marketing consent options.

marketing_consent_options.description: Marketing consent options the business offers. When present, the platform SHOULD display these to the buyer before checkout completion.
